title: Session log & tinker pad — latency micro-run summary
content:
Quick context: small, iterative perf sweep for short-sequence chat workloads. Goal is to find a low-latency, low-cost config we can surface as a 95th-percentile-friendly default for internal demo traffic. Notes are messy — this is my personal scratchpad for the session.

Objectives:
- Measure p50/p95 latency across model variants and batch settings for seq_len=32 (prompt+resp).
- Check KV cache impact for repeat-prefix requests.
- Capture cost ballparks (approx $/1k tokens) to compare quantized vs fp16.

Environment:
- region: us-west-2 (dev pool)
- hardware: a100-40GB (single GPU per worker)
- runtime: rwinf-v0.9.7 (local branch with small kernel switch)
- client: simple-bench v0.4 (concurrent=4 by default)

Run table (raw scratch):

| run | model            | batch | seq_len | kv_cache | quant  | p50_ms | p95_ms | tokens/s | est $/1k tok | notes         |
|-----|------------------|-------|---------|----------|--------|--------|--------|----------|-------------|---------------|
| r01 | rw-7b-fp16       | 1     | 32      | off      | fp16   | 42     | 110    | 780      | 0.85        | baseline fp16 |
| r02 | rw-7b-fp16       | 4     | 32      | off      | fp16   | 75     | 210    | 1400     | 0.65        | batching helps throughput, p95 up
| r03 | rw-7b-q4_0       | 1     | 32      | off      | q4_0   | 48     | 125    | 910      | 0.40        | small latency reg, huge cost win
| r04 | rw-7b-q4_0       | 4     | 32      | off      | q4_0   | 86     | 240    | 1650     | 0.30        | throughput good, p95 worse than fp16
| r05 | rw-7b-q4_0       | 1     | 32      | on       | q4_0   | 28     | 65     | 1200     | 0.38        | KV cache dramatic p95 win for repeat
| r06 | rw-7b-8bit       | 1     | 32      | on       | int8   | 32     | 78     | 1100     | 0.45        | promising middle ground

Interpretation (quick):
- KV cache on short seqs gives the biggest single improvement for p95 (r05). Good candidate for demo default when prefixes are repeated.
- Quant (q4_0) reduces cost ~2x vs fp16 but increases p95 under batching; single-request p95 fairly competitive.
- Batching aggressively increases throughput but raises p95 substantially; need to tune batching timeout or prefer single-request for low-latency SLAs.

Light-weight checklist / next-touch items:
- [ ] Re-run r05 with concurrent=8 to see contention effect (ticketed: JIRA-ENG-3112).
- [ ] Try partial-KV eviction test (small prefix + new prompt) to simulate multi-turn app.
- [ ] Add 7B->13B quick sanity to validate scaling behavior (cost vs p95 tradeoffs).
- [ ] Draft a short blurb for console default recommendation: "short-chat default: rw-7b-q4_0 + KV cache enabled, prefer batch=1" (if results hold).

Ad-hoc notes / To-self friction points:
- Observed occasional 500ms jitter in r02 during a background cluster reboot — check cluster events for run window (11:05–11:18 PT).
- The local kernel patch in rwinf-v0.9.7 may slightly affect q4 timings vs mainline; annotate in PR.
- Cost estimations are rough; need to plug real token accounting from billing export before final recommendation.

Slack refs / quick links:
- slack: #perf-lab thread "kv-cache micro-sweep" (11/05)
- gh pr: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842 (kernel switch)
- jira: JIRA-ENG-3112 for follow-ups

Short-form conclusion (for notes):
- If demos have repeated prefixes, enable KV cache by default; prefer q4_0 for cost-sensitive, single-request low-latency scenarios. Use conservative batching heuristics in Console until we solve p95 spike modes.

Random scratch (math):
- rough cost formula used here: est $/1k = (gpu_hour_cost / (tokens_per_sec * 3600)) * 1000 — super rough, ignores infra overheads.

End of session scratch. Will clean up into a tidy doc if this holds.

-- Isla

(Notes to self: keep this in users/ for now; not ready for shared_drives.)
